issues.title: findFirst with nullable email can match wrong user
issues.detail: The jwt callback uses `db.user.findFirst({ where: { email: token.email } })`. Since `email` is `String?` in the schema, if `token.email` is null (possible with GitHub accounts that hide their email), `findFirst` returns the first user row with a null email — which may belong to a different person.

issues.title: useEffect re-subscribes on every state change
issues.detail: The `useEffect` in `useToast()` depends on `[state]`, so every toast update removes and re-adds the listener. A dispatch during the gap between cleanup and re-registration can be lost. The dependency should be `[]` since `setState` is stable.

issues.title: Dismissed toasts linger ~17 minutes in DOM
issues.detail: `TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY` is 1,000,000 ms. After a toast is dismissed (set `open: false`), it remains in the toasts array and DOM for nearly 17 minutes before the REMOVE_TOAST action fires.
